description: This file defines the OnboardingWizardModel class and related UI components, managing onboarding wizard state and step UI in a SwiftUI app. It includes methods for starting, submitting, and canceling wizard sessions, as well as bridging helpers between different Codable types.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A SwiftUI observable class managing the state and interactions for the onboarding wizard process.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the wizard session if conditions are met, setting up necessary parameters and communicating with the gateway.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the current wizard step answer to the backend and processes the response.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing wizard session if it is currently running.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the wizard model.
